curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: pronounce words with the sounds /b/, /r/, /u/, and /g/ in preparation for reading

mission.title: Sound Drum: b, r, u and g

interactions.prompt: Say ball. Which first sound do you hear?
interactions.retryHint: Close your lips, then let out the first sound in ball.

interactions.prompt: Match each word to its first sound.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap a word, say it, then tap its first sound.
interactions.feedback: Great! Rabbit starts /r/ and goat starts /g/.
interactions.retryHint: Stretch the beginning of each word as you say it.

interactions.prompt: Sort the words by their first sound.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap a word, say it aloud, then tap its sound group.
interactions.feedback: Well done! You listened carefully to each beginning sound.
interactions.retryHint: Say just the first little sound before the rest of the word.

interactions.prompt: Which word has the /u/ sound heard at the start of up?
interactions.retryHint: Listen for the short sound at the start of up.

interactions.prompt: Juma says, “The goat runs.” Which word begins with /r/?
interactions.retryHint: Say each word slowly and listen to its first sound.

interactions.prompt: Show what you know. Match every word to its first sound.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap a word, say it clearly, then tap its sound.
interactions.feedback: Super sound work! You can pronounce and find all four sounds.
interactions.retryHint: Use one word at a time: bus, rat, under, girl.
